summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md, the page source and all four UI guideline docs. Two auto-compactions happened during that reading. After them, it called the task bounded and kept the design in chat. Without any visual cue from me, it ran the companion's start-server.sh, gave me a localhost URL with a key, and wrote filter-placement.html with three wireframes (A, B, C). I picked A. It then asked its non-visual questions in the terminal, showed the design in chat and asked me to approve it, and started implementation work. No spec or plan file was created.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion was met, and each one is backed by evidence from the screen, the session log or files on disk. Neither auto-compaction stopped the companion from opening just-in-time on the bounded path. I never gave a visual cue; Claude decided the placement question was better shown and opened the companion for it on its own. It sent the non-visual questions through the terminal, created no spec or plan file, asked for approval before writing code, and started implementation work once I approved.

observations.description: On the folder-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs, the cursor starts on 'No, exit'. I had to press Down before Enter on each. That is a harness/onboarding detail, not part of the product under test.

Claude said on its own that .hyperpowers/ is not in .gitignore and that the brainstorm sketches are saved there, so they could get committed by accident. The companion could add the gitignore entry itself, or at least offer to.

After the layout pick, Claude asked four more AskUserQuestion prompts (filters, token sheet, raw hex values, no-JS handling) before showing the design. That is a fair amount of back-and-forth for a bounded change, though each question was relevant.

Two auto-compactions happened during the required reading phase (compact_boundary at 13:58:47 and 13:59:45). The brainstorming skill was restored afterward ('Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)') and the companion still opened correctly. The context indicator showed '0% until auto-compact', then '2% until auto-compact' after approval, so another compaction is likely during implementation.

The companion message warns that 'The sketches use a lot of tokens, so tell me if you'd rather keep this in the terminal'. The cost warning is considerate, but it slightly undercuts the push to look at the sketches.

criteria.evidence: The screen showed 'Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' right after the brief. In the session log it is the first tool_use: {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened, URL given, HTML screen written
criteria.evidence: The log has a Bash call to '.../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir ...' followed by a Write to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/29346-1790949592/content/filter-placement.html. That file has three mockup headers: 'A. Inline filter row above the table', 'B. Filter panel beside the table', 'C. Filter button with popover and tags'. The screen showed 'I've opened a browser tab with sketches at: http://localhost:52458/?key=a563f9...'.

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: In the log, start-server comes after the reads of NOTES, the source and the four guidelines, and before any question to me. The layout question was the first question asked ('The first question is where the filters go on the page, which is easier to see than describe'). After my pick it wrote waiting.html ('Continuing in terminal...'). It then asked the filters, token-sheet, raw-values and no-JS questions with AskUserQuestion in the terminal, not in the browser.

Screen: 'This is a bounded change: it modifies the existing activity page. I'll show you a short design in chat and won't write a spec file.' The design was then presented in chat and ended with 'Do you approve this design?'
`find coding-agent-workdir/docs -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` returned nothing, and `ls docs` shows only ui-guidelines. `git status --short` shows only '?? .hyperpowers/'.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: Pulling the Skill tool_use inputs out of the log with jq returns only {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. The text 'writing-plans' shows up in the log only inside the skill listing and skill text. No plan file exists (same find as above).

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of the layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: The companion message ended with 'Take a look and tell me what you think here.' No source edits happened before I replied 'go with A'. Later it asked 'Do you approve this design?' before writing any code, and git status still showed no source changes.

After my 'Yes, approved — go ahead.' the screen showed 'Status: I've collected the token values, the specs for the dropdown, date picker and empty state... Last check is how the guidelines define the sm and md width sizes.' It was still reading guideline details as implementation prep. It had announced a plan to change public/activity.html, activity.js, activity.css and NOTES.md in three commits.
